title: Bioelectric networks are a cognitive glue that enlarges the cognitive light cone of cells

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Bioelectric networks are a cognitive glue that enlarges the cognitive light cone of cells

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Bioelectric networks, through their plasticity, multiscale historicity (memory) and learning capacity, act as a 'cognitive glue' that binds the cybernetic goal-directedness of single cells into a higher-order system pursuing larger-scale goals (a larger cognitive light cone), and this capacity is not unique to brains.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Bioelectric networks: the cognitive glue enabling evolutionary scaling from physiology to mind

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2023, Bioelectric networks: the cognitive glue enabling evolutionary scaling from physiology to mind › Bioelectricity: the ancient cognitive glue

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Bioelectric networks, with their inherent plasticity, multiscale historicity, and learning capacity, are an ideal kind of “cognitive glue” that binds the primitive goal-directedness (in the cybernetic sense) of single cells into a higher order system with a larger cognitive light cone (Fig. 1E).

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Bioelectric networks: the cognitive glue enabling evolutionary scaling from physiology to mind”, Animal cognition (2023), doi:10.1007/s10071-023-01780-3; section “Bioelectricity: the ancient cognitive glue”. Scope: Neural and non-neural cell collectives in multicellular organisms

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-glue-05: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.43

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: A restricted control-theoretic version has measurable consequences in perturbation data. The claim's cognitive language does not uniquely distinguish it from ordinary distributed physiological regulation, limiting discrimination.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Define cognitive light cone as the spatial and temporal range over which perturbations influence successful return to a measurable setpoint, then compare intact and disrupted bioelectric coupling. Increased integration range, memory, and adaptive recovery under coupling would support a restricted engineering interpretation.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Existing datasets rarely measure all proposed properties together.

Cognitive glue and higher-order goals are framework-dependent.

Coupling can improve coordination without cognition.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.3
data existence: 0.55
discriminating power: 0.35
operationalizability: 0.45
analysis feasibility: 0.48

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Tissue-scale bioelectric coupling is measurable, and that measurement does not require the cognitive vocabulary. The claim's extra content, that these networks are a cognitive glue enlarging a light cone of goals, is not separated from physiological integration by any available observation. The statement is therefore not empirically resolvable as opposed to its non-cognitive restatement.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Gap-junction and ion-channel coupling that coordinates cells over a larger distance and a longer time is predicted equally by ordinary bioelectric physiology. No observation distinguishes that coordination from a cognitive glue that binds cellular goals into a larger cognitive light cone, in brain or non-brain tissue.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Any physiological dataset offered as support is also a non-cognitive description of the same facts.

Cognitive glue, goal-directedness, and cognitive light cone do not fix a single measurement.

data existence: 0.2
